name: @amykit/plugin-codex
description: The codex CLI as the agent, over its JSONL event stream.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when the agent should be Codex, run through the codex CLI. It contributes a harness and a usage reader to agent-relay, which must be installed beside it. At mount it checks that the installed codex speaks the app-server protocol it was built against, and refuses to mount otherwise. Codex reports no cost of its own, so a ceiling in money needs the price table to carry the model.
